entries.title: Psalms 2:1
segments: ¶Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing? {rage: or, tumultuously assemble} {imagine: Heb. meditate}

entries.title: Psalms 2:2
segments: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, [saying],

entries.title: Psalms 2:3
segments: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

entries.title: Psalms 2:4
segments: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.

entries.title: Psalms 2:5
segments: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure. {vex: or, trouble}

entries.title: Psalms 2:6
segments: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion. {set: Heb. anointed} {upon...: Heb. upon Zion, the hill of my holiness}

words.text: . {set: Heb. anointed} {upon...: Heb. upon Zion, the hill of my holiness}

entries.title: Psalms 2:7
segments: ¶I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou [art] my Son; this day have I begotten thee. {the decree: or, for a decree}

words.text: thee. {the decree: or, for a decree}

entries.title: Psalms 2:8
segments: Ask of me, and I shall give [thee] the heathen [for] thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth [for] thy possession.

words.text: of me, and I shall give

entries.title: Psalms 2:9
segments: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

words.text: ; thou shalt dash them in pieces

entries.title: Psalms 2:10
segments: ¶Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 2:11
segments: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

entries.title: Psalms 2:12
segments: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish [from] the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed [are] all they that put their trust in him.

words.text: [are] all they that put their trust
